text:
caroline: Quick flag - onboarding sampleapp fails when built for Edge. Vite dev OK, build+deploy hits a runtime error.

mike: Error text?

caroline: Runtime stack: 
```
TypeError: Cannot redefine property: exports
    at Object.defineProperty (<anonymous>)
    at Object.<anonymous> (.../node_modules/@redwood/inference-js/dist/cjs/index.js:12:15)
```

caroline: Also Vite prerender shows: 
```
SyntaxError: module '/node_modules/@redwood/inference-js/dist/cjs/index.js' does not provide export 'createClient'
```

sasha: Sounds like bundler is resolving to the CJS package for ESM imports. We've seen Rollup and Vite picking the wrong entry when package.exports ordering is off.

mike: Which SDK version?

caroline: @redwood/inference-js@2.1.0-canary.2026.03.20. Downgrading to 2.0.4 avoids the defineProperty error but causes TS type mismatches.

sasha: Short-term workarounds: add `ssr.noExternal: ['@redwood/inference-js']` for Vite, or alias to `@redwood/inference-js/dist/esm/index.js` in bundler config. Explicit import of the ESM file also works.

mike: I'll prepare a patch for types (.d.ts) to match the constructor shape, and we should normalize package.exports order + stop CJS from redefining exports.

caroline: I put a tiny repro gist in the ticket infra-inference#2289. CI (vite/rollup/webpack) kicked off by @dev-bot.

dev-bot: CI started for infra-inference#2289 (matrix: vite/rollup/webpack).

sasha: I'll add a smoke CI job: pack the SDK and run Vite build + vercel dev --edge to catch this before release.

caroline: Added the Vite workaround to onboarding docs and sampleapp. Leaving the repro in the issue for engineering.
